title: Money: escrow, credit, payouts
description: ADR-012/013/019 targets and live queues. Confirm table/column names against packages/db/prisma/schema/escrow.prisma when the schema changes.

panels.title: Escrow dispute-refund rate (fraud proxy, <0.5%)
panels.description: Escrows funded that were refunded by a dispute decision within 60d.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, value AS "escrow_dispute_refund_rate" FROM metric_daily WHERE metric='escrow_dispute_refund_rate' AND dimension='' AND $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Payout latency, median minutes (<1440)
panels.description: metric_daily.escrow_payout_minutes; cohort-anchored, recent days keep changing until the window matures (docs/design/metrics.md).

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, value AS "escrow_payout_minutes" FROM metric_daily WHERE metric='escrow_payout_minutes' AND dimension='' AND $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Dispute resolution, median minutes (<=10080 = 7d)
panels.description: metric_daily.dispute_resolution_minutes; cohort-anchored, recent days keep changing until the window matures (docs/design/metrics.md).

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, value AS "dispute_resolution_minutes" FROM metric_daily WHERE metric='dispute_resolution_minutes' AND dimension='' AND $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Disputes auto-resolved
panels.description: metric_daily.dispute_auto_resolution_rate; cohort-anchored, recent days keep changing until the window matures (docs/design/metrics.md).

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, value AS "dispute_auto_resolution_rate" FROM metric_daily WHERE metric='dispute_auto_resolution_rate' AND dimension='' AND $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Credit 90+ DPD loan share (GNPA proxy, <2%)
panels.description: Count-based proxy; true GNPA is outstanding-weighted, see credit admin page.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, value AS "credit_npa_rate_proxy" FROM metric_daily WHERE metric='credit_npa_rate_proxy' AND dimension='' AND $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Escrowed orders with credit attached (>=15%)
panels.description: Order-count proxy of the GMV-weighted ADR target.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, value AS "credit_attached_order_share" FROM metric_daily WHERE metric='credit_attached_order_share' AND dimension='' AND $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day

SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, metric, value FROM metric_daily WHERE metric IN ('escrows_funded','credit_disbursals','credit_overdue_events','subscription_starts','subscription_cancels') AND dimension='' AND $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Escrow payouts by status (live)
panels.description: Pending payouts older than one business day breach the ADR-012 target.

targets.rawSql: SELECT status, count(*) AS payouts, COALESCE(sum(amount_paise),0)/100.0 AS rupees, min(requested_at) AS oldest FROM escrow_payouts GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

panels.title: Escrow reconciliation issues
panels.description: Open rows need finance attention (admin issue queue).

targets.rawSql: SELECT status, count(*) AS issues, min(created_at) AS oldest FROM escrow_reconciliation_issues GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
